---
title: "cleanresults in a Quarto manuscript"
format:
  html: default
  docx: default
  pdf: default
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(cleanresults)
d <- read.csv("study1.csv")
d$condition <- factor(d$condition, levels = c("Control", "Gain", "Loss"))

res <- clean_regress(
  d,
  dvs = c(trust = "linear", donated = "logistic", shared = "logistic"),
  predictors = ~ condition + age,
  random = ~ (1 | id),
  contrasts = "condition",       # pairwise contrasts, Holm-adjusted within factor
  dv_adjust = "holm",            # plus a correction across the 3 outcomes
  dv_adjust_terms = "condition",
  labels = c(condition = "Condition", age = "Age (years)"),
  dv_labels = c(trust = "Trust", donated = "Donated", shared = "Shared")
)
```

Loss framing increased sharing relative to control,
`r cr_inline(res, "shared", "condition", "Loss")` (@tbl-main).

```{r}
#| label: tbl-main
#| tbl-cap: "Effects of framing on trust, donation, and sharing"
cr_table(res)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-stargazer
#| tbl-cap: "The same models, stargazer style"
cr_table(res, style = "se", fit = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: export
#| include: false
# Files for Overleaf, Word, and Google Docs
cr_save(res, "tables/table1.tex", caption = "Effects of framing", label = "tab:main")
cr_save(res, "tables/table1.docx")
cr_save(res, "tables/table1.html")
```
